h1: Custom Direct to Film Seat Cushions
metaTitle: Custom Direct to Film Seat Cushions | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to film seat cushions for your team or event. Vibrant, durable prints on bulk orders. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Direct to film printing on seat cushions gives you photo-quality detail and vibrant colors without the setup costs of embroidery or screen printing. This method works especially well for complex logos, gradients, or small text that needs to stay legible on foam or gel cushion covers. Whether you are outfitting an office ergonomics program or creating giveaways for a trade show, DTF transfers bond securely to polyester and nylon fabrics used in most promotional seat cushions, delivering a soft hand feel that won't crack or peel after repeated use.
heroAltText: Custom direct to film seat cushions with a full-color company logo printed on a black cushion pad.
